atomicity.reason: One obligation: set the isolation fault below 500 ohm/V. The second sentence explains the ratio, it adds no obligation.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained: names both measured quantities, the ratio, the limit and its source.

feasibility.reason: Standard insulation-monitoring-device function; contradicts nothing else stated.

parent_fit.reason: Directly realises the story's promise that a degrading barrier is reported, with the criterion the story leaves open (how degraded) pinned to the ISO 6469-1 figure.

unambiguity.reason: It does not say what happens when the pack voltage is near zero (the ratio is undefined) nor when the fault clears, so a reader can take 'whenever' as latching or as cyclic.
unambiguity.suggestion: State the pack-voltage validity precondition and whether the fault clears when the ratio recovers; the software requirements already decide both.

verifiability.reason: Threshold, unit and the two measured inputs are all named; a bench can inject a resistance and a pack voltage and observe the fault.

summary: Concrete and traceable; the de-energised case and the clearing behaviour are decided one level down and should be stated here too.
